newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev ends flat at 216.70-217.50 to dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev ends flat at 216.70-217.50 to dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev traded between 216.70-217.50 at the close of the interbank market, unchanged from 216.80-217.80 morning levels as foreign currency supply met moderate demand, dealers said.
"Trade was very thin as banks were mainly servicing final clients," a commercial bank dealer said.

A rise in foreign currency demand pressured the lev to 218 per dollar in the early afternoon, but buyers soon withdrew from the market and the lev recovered to opening levels where it idled until the close, traders said. @
The central bank was closely watching the market and dealers assume it might have bought small dollar volumes after last week's sales.
Those sales locked trade in a 216-217 levs per dollar range last week, preventing a lev fall. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
